detailed_descriptions.en: Fight for control during the Friso-Hollandic Wars. Set in the medieval 13th century, the game features a strategy campaign and historical battles. Fight alongside your army in 3rd person battles and command your troops in this strategy-action game. Voor de kroon is a medieval wargame. The game uses Unreal Engine and Metahuman technology to make the historically researched characters come alive. Fight in medieval battles: participate in 13th century skirmishes or play intense siege battles. Conquer a historical recreation of the 13th century low countries. Manage your settlements and officers. Eliminate your enemies. Dive into rich customization options in the 'Warforge' editor which allow you to create your own factions, swords, castles, units and campaigns and share them in the Steam workshop. Solo developed with ♥ in The Netherlands

Voor de kroon is a medieval wargame.

The game uses Unreal Engine and Metahuman technology to make the historically researched characters come alive.

Fight in medieval battles: participate in 13th century skirmishes or play intense siege battles.

Dive into rich customization options in the 'Warforge' editor which allow you to create your own factions, swords, castles, units and campaigns and share them in the Steam workshop.
